text:
release-captain: Heads-up — release window closes in ~45m (16:00 PT). PR #5182 contains the tokenizer regression fix we promised. We need two approvals to merge into release/v1.9.2 before cutoff. @kevin @ellie can you take a look?

kevin: I can review now, give me ~15m. Any CI quirks I should know about?

ellie: On it. Quick skim looks okay but will run locally for the edge-case repro.

maria: FYI CI builds are green for the branch except one flaky integration test (integration/streaming_timeout). Link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/9876 — I re-triggered it.

sachin: Heads-up — there's a small merge conflict with release notes in release/v1.9.2. I can rebase once PR is approved.

kevin: Found a tiny thing in tokenizer.py — off-by-one when sequence len == 0. Patch suggestion:

```
if len(tokens) == 0:
    return []
```

rather than the previous guard. Tests pass locally.

ellie: Verified the fix with the repro from issue #2031, works for me. Leaving a comment on the PR with the explanation.

kevin: Approving now. :thumbsup: 

release-captain: That's one approval, thanks. We still need a second. @sachin or @maria can you second?

maria: I can take a quick look and approve if CI stays green. Give me 10m.

sachin: I'll do the merge/sync with release notes after approvals.

deploy-bot: [auto] Build 9876 re-run complete — all checks passed. (link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/9876)

maria: Approved. Left a note about the integration test flakiness (ticketed).

release-captain: Two approvals obtained and CI is green. Planning to merge at T+5 to give time for canary verification. If anyone objects, speak now.

kevin: No objections. Thanks everyone.

sachin: Merging now and will push the release candidate tag.

release-captain: Merge complete. Tag: v1.9.2-rc1. Monitoring in console for the next 30m. :eyes:
